verdict.rationale: Morph documents its own train-then-serve flow, but only for Custom Reflexes. You send labeled examples, a training job produces a small text classifier in about 30 seconds, and you then classify text against it through the same API. Nothing in the evidence shows fine-tuning the open-weight chat models (e.g. Kimi K3), and the dedicated endpoints only reserve capacity for existing models. missing for 10: fine-tuning of the supported base/chat models on user data, serving fine-tuned chat models via the chat endpoint or dedicated endpoints, documentation of training data formats or hyperparameters, independent or hands-on corroboration.
